voievodat.name: The Voivodeship
voievodat.description: Men of the valleys. Strong walls, steady coin, and churches whose bells unsettle the creatures of the night.

zmei.name: The Zmei
zmei.description: Dragon-kin of the high peaks. Few in number, terrible in battle, and greedy beyond measure.

iele.name: The Iele
iele.description: Fairies of the deep woods. Swift and unseen among the trees, their endless dance drives intruders mad.

strigoi.name: The Strigoi
strigoi.description: The restless dead of the marshes. Cheap, countless and slow, and stronger with every grave they open.

haiduci.name: Haiduc Rebels
haiduci.description: Outlaws of the forests who rise wherever lords rule badly.
